legacy_block_layout: ACOM1\x00 + little-endian u64 length + little-endian u32 CRC32 +32SHA256bytes + zlib/DEFLATE. ONLY compatible with app iald_web/app/patents/acom_codec.py. Central dispositivo/acom_codec.py has a different JSON-header layout.
framing: u32 big-endian canonical JSON header bytes, then exactly header.wire payload bytes for block; begin/end have no payload.
state: Server-scoped immutable manifest root over scope,object hash,length,ordered block(hash,length). References only from explicitly declared base. No arbitrary cache existence probe.

limits.not_production_limits: Existing chat20MiB and document/media limits are separate; prototype must not lower production limits.

stream: Receiver spools bytes to isolated disk; verified block callback provisional until valid end/root. require_eof=False completes on explicit end without waiting EOF; request mode rejects trailing bytes.
security: Trusted server Context flags are synthetic test adapter only; not real login/CSRF. Hash integrity is not authentication. No provider calls or integration.
eviction: Missing base/block refuses before dispatch. Explicit cold transfer only; no automatic retry after uncertain send. RAM lease option NOT implemented.
